payload.title: Calls — regenerate the stale product-test call-schema fixture
payload.description: The committed product-test schema wire fixture (conformance/fixtures/wire/*.bin, loaded by frick_conformance::product_test_schema()) carries a STALE, partial call schema: CallRoom is missing the 'kind' field (and likely other drift) vs. the current frick_server::calls::schema defs. So a live CallCommand Create packed against the bare fixture fails ('Unknown field kind'); the FR-290 conformance scenarios work around it by stripping the stale call types and runtime-splicing the current call_*_defs (see crates/frick-conformance/tests/calls.rs + ServerHandle::in_process_with_schema). Task: regenerate the .bin fixture so its call types match the current call schema, regenerate the cross-language golden codegen fixtures (conformance/fixtures/codegen/{swift,kotlin,typescript}), update any schema-hash assertions, and simplify tests/calls.rs to drop the splice. RISK: schema-hash change ripples into golden fixtures — must keep ALL codegen + conformance + schema-golden tests green; if not safely achievable, leave the working splice + report.
